text:
alex: Quick sync — planning to cut release/1.18 tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Need someone to create the branch and own initial cherry-picks/backports. Who can take the origination? :shipit:

maria: I can create the branch and run preflight checks. Please list the must-backport PRs so I can queue them. :+1:

alex: Priority backports: PR#1234 (migration fix), PR#2345 (changelog/version bump), PR#3456 (docs tweak). Security fixes go to release/1.17 as well — we'll coordinate those separately.

kevin: I can handle the changelog/version bump and tagging once branch exists. @maria ping me when pushed.

jamie: Heads up — proto changes are on freeze. Any PR touching api/proto should be excluded from automated backports and flagged for API-review.

sasha: Quick question — do we want squash merges for release branch or merge commits to preserve authors? I prefer merge commits. :thinking_face:

alex: Merge commits — keep history. Also follow the usual backport rules: include original authors, add `Backport: <pr-url>` in commit message, and use `-x` with cherry-pick.

release-bot: Reminder: release window reserved 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC. Set your canaries by EOD.

maria: Branch created and pushed: `git checkout -b release/1.18 origin/main` then `git push origin release/1.18`. Link: https://git.redwood.example/release/1.18 (private). :tada:

kevin: Cherry-pick pattern I'm using: ```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout release/1.18
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, then
git commit
git push origin release/1.18
```

maria: Cherry-picked PR#2345 (changelog) and PR#3456 (docs). PR#1234 (migration) has a merge conflict — assigning to @jamie to confirm conflict resolution.

jamie: I'll take the migration conflict. If it's large, we may prefer to backport the fix as a small pod/patch instead of the whole change. Will update in ~1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: Once migration is resolved, I'll run the release notes script and tag rc. Also, please add any extra backports to the `release/1.18/backports` check run in the PR template.

alex: Nice work. Minor ask — call out any changes that touch runtime config in the PR description so ops can review. After tagging, I'll kick off the canary rollout plan.

maria: Done — added a short checklist to the branch readme and linked open backport PRs. @kevin you should be able to run the release-notes job now.

kevin: Running notes job now. ETA 10m. :eyes:

alex: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks the migration backport, escalate here. Otherwise we proceed with cut at 10:00 PT tomorrow.

sasha: Thanks — will watch for the tag and verify integration tests on the release branch. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Cut checklist updated: branch created, changelog applied, docs backported, migration pending. https://ci.redwood.example/checklists/3160007321

alex: Closing the async loop — final callout: for any emergency security backports, ping #incidents and tag me. Otherwise, party on release/1.18. :party_popper:
